title: Gulf Royale 30A | KEY.co
description_expanded: Perched along the sugar-white quartz sands and turquoise waters of Seacrest Beach, this stunning Gulf-front retreat offers an elevated coastal experience with direct beach access and breathtaking views. Designed with Cape Dutch–inspired architecture and modern luxury in mind, the three-level home features five bedrooms and five-and-a-half bathrooms across the main house and private carriage house, comfortably accommodating up to 16 guests. Expansive living and dining spaces are framed by sweeping Gulf vistas. At the same time, the gourmet kitchen—complete with a Sub-Zero double refrigerator, Wolf six-burner range, dual dishwashers, and island seating—creates an ideal setting for shared meals and effortless entertaining. A media room with a wet bar, a bonus kitchenette, elevator access, and multiple balconies enhance the home’s thoughtful design and relaxed elegance. Outdoor living is just as exceptional, centered around a heated Gulf-front pool, an outdoor kitchen with a built-in grill, and an inviting fire pit, perfect for sunset gatherings. Each morning begins with complimentary beach service, featuring two chairs and an umbrella set just steps away along the shoreline. Six adult bikes make exploring Seacrest Beach and nearby coastal communities easy, while the carriage house adds privacy with additional bedrooms, including a bunk room ideal for larger groups. With panoramic Gulf views, curated amenities, and seamless access to the beach, this remarkable property captures the essence of luxurious coastal living along 30A.

Features: Guests assume all risk for use of pools
